facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but under CEMAC exchange control; repatriate earnings through your bank.
facts.P2_fcy_account: No: residents can't open foreign-currency accounts locally; declare accounts abroad.
facts.P3_local_gateways: MTN MoMo and Airtel Money dominate; no gateway for individuals found.
facts.L1_registration: Register through ACPCE, the one-stop shop, now also online.
facts.L2_tax_id: NIU from the tax directorate (DGID), shown on your invoices.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed; under FCFA 100m turnover, a flat-rate IGF regime applies.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 18.9% VAT above FCFA 100m turnover; no zero rate for exported services found.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 29-2019: declare data processing to the protection commission.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: E-commerce law 37-2019 exists, but its refund rules weren't found.
facts.L7_incentives: No freelancer incentive; the IGF flat regime is the main simplification.

watch_out.text: Declare any accounts you hold abroad to the BEAC.
